hypothesis: A registry of admitted scalar borrowed callees plus opaque checked aggregate roots can borrow a projected String without transferring its parent or child ownership.
expectedBoundary: Only observer-plan admission changes; refused plans retain ordinary owning program execution.

cases.scenario: Two shared String roots; equal, first-difference and suffix-difference inputs.
cases.required: Borrowed wrapper admits; complete Bool and retained strings match; borrowed worker contains no root keep/drop.

cases.scenario: KTerm, KLambda and KLiteral, matching and nonmatching keys.
cases.required: All routes preserve Bool and retained complete term; widths are 8, 8 and 5.

cases.scenario: A uniquely owned term and key enter the ordinary public entry.
cases.required: Existing unique-input fallback remains correct; no claim that shared-root routing optimizes this case.

cases.scenario: Both equality inputs alias the same String root.
cases.required: Both owned handles remain correctly accounted for; no retain/delete shortcut based only on pointer equality.

cases.scenario: The tag String is independently retained while its KTerm parent is observed and later released.
cases.required: The child alias and the complete parent remain readable for their required lifetimes.

cases.scenario: An observer-shaped function returns the projected String after consuming its parent.
cases.required: Observer plan refuses; owning fallback retains/transfers the escaping child correctly.

cases.scenario: A borrowed child is stored in a returned constructor or closure.
cases.required: Scalar borrowed-call lane refuses the escape, including indirect captures.

cases.scenario: A child is passed to an ordinary consuming helper or to an observer adapter.
cases.required: Borrowed plan refuses unless the child receives separately proved ownership; this design supplies no such transfer.

cases.scenario: A helper can store a child through foreign code, an effect or parallel work.
cases.required: Borrowed call is refused and ordinary effect/demand behavior remains intact.

cases.scenario: A field of List<KTerm> is matched or passed under an erased List<String> identity.
cases.required: Opaque applied fields cannot gain capabilities from owner-name equality.

cases.scenario: A source book defines names resembling private observer workers or marks a raw book as permitted.
cases.required: Only successful checked route admission creates a usable certificate; permission-disabled compilation creates none.

cases.scenario: Indexed/dependent constructors, native Array layout, unary packed user constructors, or fields wider than the fixed bound.
cases.required: Unsupported representations retain explicit refusal; KTerm requires no width-bound change.

cases.scenario: Two not-yet-admitted helper observers call one another.
cases.required: No circular certificate bootstrapping; retries stop within their fixed budget.

cases.scenario: Three-character virtual String versus runtime key, plus longer and non-decreasing helper recursions.
cases.required: Short constants may specialize only within existing depth/fuel bounds; all exhausted plans refuse without partial admission.

cases.scenario: A recursive cursor call is discarded or followed by scalar work.
cases.required: Existing NO_Loop tail-result obligation remains enforced.

cases.scenario: A discarded argument contains a demanding scalar conversion or failure.
cases.required: Borrowed calls preserve strict argument demand and existing error checks; no folding away observable failure.
